Still best restaurant in HCM for my Family
Sep 2022
It's been almost 3 years since we have been back to Ho Chi Minh city so we were hopeful Lion City was still open (sadly many places have shuttered during the pandemic induced closures). The Good: Fortunately, the Ben Thanh area restaurant was open!! My 15 yr old wanted the chili crab, and raved about it for the past few years. THE GREAT: It was just as delicious as we remembered it!! The owner, Harry Ang, greeted us as we are a large family of 6 from Canada. He put together a special menu of concoctions just for us noting my kids range from 9 to 17. Ha ha (eg. Fish and chips, sweet & sour chicken, "samba" long bean, roti)!! Four kids have different tastes and we were in HCM for 8 days, and ate at LC twice!! It's that good.

Special mention: the service staff are truly awesome. Very attentive to our needs. For example, they must have changed our dirty plates after every second dish!! Also, they made sure to set aside finished dishes just to ensure we had sufficient space!! That is next level service!!

Had better food in a second rate food court in Singapore
May 2022 • Solo
Went there for dinner looking for some familiar comfort food. Was tempted to try the Chilli Crab but the wisdom of the years prevailed.

Decided to try something take can possibly not go wrong and placed my bet on KungPo Chicken with Congee.

Guess what? I lost 😢

The congee was akin to thick starch and the gravy for the chicken had the consistency of black treacle.

The only saving grace was the taste of the gravy was decent with the right amount of “spicy kick.”

Service was acceptable but in terms of food quality vis-à-vis price, I would rate it as low.

Will I go again? Well, it depends on how desperate I am. 🤔

Best food We had in Ho Chi Minh
Jan 2020 • Family
We stayed in HCM for a week and I admit that we are used to North American Vietnamese food (so yes, slightly diluted) so my kids and I were in a bit of shock over the authentic Viet food we were eating at local restaurants. On the advice of some friends we decided to try LC and I'm glad I did. Prior, I had to get McDonald's, KFC, etc for my young kids! But at LC, my kids enjoyed the Roti bread, chicken wings, and i LOVED the chili crab (and later chili lobster) and mango slush drink. Very kid friendly staff and service. We must have ate-in, OR GRAB -ed takeout several times over the week.

Yes, it's pricier than local Viet food but still alot cheaper than a night out at the Keg or Cactus Club here in Vancouver Canada.

Flavoursome fresh food, on the pricier side
Nov 2019
We had the Singapore noodles and the chicken curry. Both were very well cooked with great depth of flavour and tasted fresh, with a good spice kick. While the service was attentive, they do try to upsell you from the reasonably priced chicken / stir-fry dishes to the quite high-price seafood items. 
Restaurant was clean and airy overall. However, while for Western people the total spend was not excessive, this is not a cheap restaurant by Ho Chi Minh City standards, so expect to pay prices higher than most .
